basic_info.description: Timeless 1920s Charm in the Heart of Outer Sunset!    Location, Location, Location! Discover the perfect blend of timeless character and modern potential in this delightful 1920s single-family home. Step inside to discover beautiful period details, including classic wainscoting that adds warmth and elegance to the living and formal dining rooms.  Featuring two spacious bedrooms, a one-car garage with ample storage, and a versatile bonus room downstairs, this home offers both charm and functionality. The extra-deep lot boasts a generous backyardan open canvas awaiting your vision, whether it's a lush garden, play area, or outdoor entertaining space.  Just moments from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, public transportation and vibrant neighborhood shops and cafs, this home is an incredible opportunity to create your dream coastal retreat. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Outer Sunset's history!
